data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for native rectangular and circular image cropping.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that provides native performance for rectangular and circular cropping using Kotlin and Swift. It includes a CropPreview widget with customizable drag points, masks, and a controller to retrieve crop sizes and execute crops.
use_when: You need high-performance image cropping backed by native code.
You want support for both rectangular and circular cropping out of the box.
avoid_when: You are on the web platform and require JPEG support or a crop mask without background color workaround.
You need complex image manipulation features beyond cropping.
strengths: Better performance due to native Kotlin/Swift implementations.
Usable both as a widget or directly via methods.
Highly customizable drag points and crop masks.
weaknesses: Web platform currently only supports cropping to PNG format and has issues rendering the crop mask properly.
Web platform isolates are not supported, which may cause UI freezing for large images.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need pure Dart image processing and manipulation without native platform dependencies.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you primarily need to pick images from the device gallery or camera rather than exclusively crop them.
